title: paphiopedilum villosum f. affine

This plant is known for its unique characteristics, including its fragrant flowers and ability to thrive in low-light conditions. The Bearded Venus Slipper Orchid is also valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting relaxation and calmness through its therapeutic actions.
